about: Off-air bars v3.2 (平面视觉 · 广告, 2026-11-03): the plate plus the runtime key for the live date and clock. Spec: Documentation/AD_TYPE_SYSTEM.md §3.6. Generator: Tools/screens/offair.py.

cells.note: x, y = the top-left of a row's first cell; sprite i goes at (x + i * pitch - margin, y - margin), all at 1x; multiply every number by 2 for @2x

date.source: the real month and day in 1990; a real Feb 29 shows 02-28-90 (FrontRoomsTerminalContent.GameDate)

time.source: the device's local time (FrontRoomsTerminalContent.Now), 24-hour, leading zeros

tick: Read the clock every frame; redraw a row only when its string changes (once a second for the time). Hard cut, no blink, no fade, no smoothing.

window.note: the station's off-air states play only in this window (AD_TYPE_SYSTEM.md §3.4)

composite: In sRGB-encoded 8-bit values, never in linear light: out = plate * (1 - a) + rgb * a, a = alpha / 255. To redraw a row, copy that row's rectangle back from the plate, then composite its 8 sprites left to right.
